# Is your Dockerfile's base image still supported?

> Paste your Dockerfile and find every FROM line whose base image release has passed its own end-of-life date. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
